messages:
mika: Heads-up: rolling maintenance for apac-south GPU pool Sun 23:00-00:30 UTC. NIC firmware + kernel patch + BMC soft-reset. Expect ~2 nodes per cohort offline.

cho: We'll stagger across 3 racks, canary on rack-2/node-01.

sre_oncall: I'll own pager. Rollback if p99 > 300ms for >2m or RX errors spike.

mika: Preheat: seed top-50 KV to apac-east 30m prior and scale apac-east +1. Set routing fallback to small-model for 20m if cohort reduces capacity.

ops-bot: Ticket OPS-7780 created. Customer notices scheduled 24h and 1h before.

cho: Command for drain: kubectl drain node/rack2-01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120

mika: Finance: estimated cross-region costs ~USD 95. Notified.

sre_oncall: Be in VC for first cohort. I'll join.

ops-bot: Reminders set: 24h->#support, 1h->#ops, 10m->oncall.
